Scouts Help Out Baby Dinosaurs Trapped on a Meatball Asteroid! ☄️ | Star Trek: Scouts FULL EPISODE | Blaze and the Monster Machines

Some baby dinosaurs were snacking on a giant meatball asteroid, but now they're stuck! Watch the Star Trek Scouts, JR, Roo, and Sprocket, go on a rescue mission to save the little dinos and get them back to their mama. They'll use space tech like hover boards and Sprocket's extendo-arm to help save the day, and continue their mission to Discover, Grow, and Boldly Go!

Meet the Star Trek Scouts! JR, Roo, and Sprocket are three best friends in training to become Star Trek Scout explorers. Watch as they launch asteroids, solve spacey problems, and work together to save the day in outer space with their pet sidekicks, Zips, Bubbles, and Star.
